name: c130jump
steps: log the jump procedure on the drop run: jumpmaster commands, the checklist card, door bundle first, static lines and trailing deployment bags

eval (()=>{ const I=__G.ISLANDS.find(i=>i.name==='WELLSPRING'); let best=null; for(let a=0;a<6.28;a+=0.3) for(let r=8;r<60;r+=4){ const x=I.x+Math.cos(a)*r, z=I.z+Math.sin(a)*r, h=__G.terrainH(x,z); if(h>2 && Math.hypot(x-I.pad.x,z-I.pad.z)>18 && (!best||Math.abs(h-I.pad.h)<Math.abs(best.h-I.pad.h))) best={x,z,h}; } __G.H.reset(new __G.THREE.Vector3(best.x, best.h+1.2, best.z), 0, true, 0); __G.D.hp.rotor=0.3; __G.G.fuel=8; window.__b=best; return best })()

eval ({bundle: __G.drop.state.bundleOK, d: Math.round(Math.hypot(__G.drop.state.bundle.p.x-__b.x, __G.drop.state.bundle.p.z-__b.z)), stage: __G.drop.state.jm.stage, men: __G.drop.state.jumpers.map(j => Math.round(Math.hypot(j.p.x-__b.x, j.p.z-__b.z)))})
